name: New Systemd Service or LaunchAgent Created
description: Detects creation of a new service unit file in /etc/systemd/system or LaunchAgent plist in ~/Library/LaunchAgents.
explanation: Adversaries install custom systemd units or LaunchAgents to survive reboots and maintain persistent daemon execution.
investigation_steps: Read the ExecStart or ProgramArguments defined in the unit/plist.
Verify whether the target binary exists and hash its contents.
Check user permissions and audit log for who installed the service.
